subject.title: Add Even Hub glasses bootstrap identity

question: Should OpenClaw core recognize `openclaw-even-g2-node` with signed `platform: "even-hub"` and `deviceFamily: "glasses"` metadata as eligible for the existing setup-code bootstrap path and bounded operator handoff?
rationale: The patch is narrow and proof-backed, but it changes a Gateway auth trust boundary and establishes durable wire-level identity for an external glasses app, which automation cannot decide.

options.title: Approve Narrow Identity After Refresh
options.body: Accept the proposed id/metadata contract, require a mergeability refresh, and leave app placement plus command policy to the linked product-direction issue.

options.title: Rename Or Generalize First
options.body: Ask the contributor to switch to the maintainer-preferred durable id and refresh the external-app proof before merge.

options.title: Keep It External For Now
options.body: Do not add a core bootstrap identity yet; keep Even Hub on generic node/plugin paths until maintainers choose the ownership model.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Identity After Refresh
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed id/metadata contract, require a mergeability refresh, and leave app placement plus command policy to the linked product-direction issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway auth/protocol history makes `steipete` the strongest routing candidate for the client-id and security-boundary decision.
